description: box [-5,-5,2]–[5,5,4] minus an elliptic cylinder (major radius 3 along x, minor 1.5, axis z, base at the origin, height 6) whose ellipse spans the box in x and y and whose z range holds the box's: Open CASCADE builds the box with an elliptical hole through it, Arris refuses at the first face pair the pave model examines with OpError::Unsupported naming the elliptic-cylinder face, since the quadric guard refuses a boolean with an elliptic operand before any intersector is trusted (ADR-0014, boolean/pave.rs). Elliptic-faced operands are C3's (docs/BACKLOG.md)
